title: Monotonicity of representation width
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, let $G$ be an AND or OR gate, and let $u,v$ be nonnegative integers with $u\le v$. If $f$ has width at most $u$ in the normal form associated with $G$, then it has width at most $v$ in that normal form.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
Choice of an AND or OR gate
Nonnegative integers u and v with u ≤ v
Width-at-most-u representation in the normal form associated with the gate
